items.title: Baxter hires new CFO with visa contingency
items.summary: John Rogers is expected to take the Deerfield, Illinois-based medical device company’s CFO seat on Oct. 1.

items.title: Baxter hires CFO from Smith & Nephew

items.title: Baxter’s interim CFO leaves for Cardinal Health
items.summary: Anita Zielinski will join Cardinal Health in November as its new chief accounting officer.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 with Questionable Fundamentals
items.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

items.title: WST Stock Surges 38.1% Since March-End: What's Fueling the Rally?
items.summary: West Pharmaceutical Services has surged 38.1% since March-end as HVP demand, GLP-1 growth and productivity gains fuel the rally.

items.title: Omnicell Raises 2026 EPS Outlook as Memory Costs Pressure Margins
items.summary: OMCL raised its 2026 EPS outlook after a strong second quarter, but rising memory-chip costs and delayed hospital purchases could test margins.

items.title: Does Cardinal Health’s New CAO and Recalls Reveal Shifts in Its Risk Profile and Earnings Quality (CAH)?
